title: dermatology_morphology
description: Stage A teacher output. Visual findings only. No diagnosis, no gold label, no disease-associated inference. Palpation and unseen body sites are not_assessable, not invented.

image_quality.description: Whether the image is sufficient for a visual description. not_evaluable requires remaining fields to be not_assessable or empty.

modality.description: Acquisition type. Dermoscopic signs in additional_features are allowed only when this is dermoscopy.

primary_lesion.description: Dominant primary lesion morphology. Pigmentation belongs in color. Scale, crust and ulceration belong in secondary_morphology unless the presenting lesion is itself an ulcer or erosion.

size.description: Approximate size in the frame. Do not invent millimetres. cannot_assess if there is no scale or the crop prevents judgement.

color.description: Visible colours. Use not_assessable as the only item when colour cannot be judged.

shape.description: Form or symmetry of the individual lesion. Arrangement of multiple lesions belongs in configuration.

border.description: Visible margin / demarcation of the lesion.

surface.description: Contour or texture that is not a named secondary change. Do not infer palpation.

secondary_morphology.description: Visible secondary surface changes. Empty if none are clearly present.

configuration.description: How lesions are arranged in the visible field, not the inferred full-body pattern.

distribution.description: Body-site pattern that is actually visible. Do not infer unseen sites.

additional_features.description: Optional extra visual signs. Empty if none are clearly visible. Dermoscopic-only signs (blue-white veil, pigment network, atypical pigment network, dots and globules, streaks, regression structures, structureless area, shiny white lines, milia-like cysts) require modality=dermoscopy.
